About Me

Hi! I'm Mustapha El Bouazaoui — a cybersecurity and telecom engineer and math enthusiast.

🔐 My main interests are cryptography, machine learning, and algorithms.

I hold a Master's degree in Cybersecurity Engineering from IMT Atlantique, France, where I specialized in areas like penetration testing, PKI, advanced cryptography, and network security. My academic background also includes strong foundations in mathematics, physics, and computer science.

My professional experience includes working as an R&D Engineer at +Simple Assurtech, where I focused on vulnerability management, attack surface management, and developing internal security APIs. I also completed an R&D internship at Nokia, focusing on 5G network security (specifically the NRF function) and integrating Microsoft Sentinel for SIEM.

I'm proficient in various technologies including Python, C++, SQL, Linux, FastAPI, PyTorch, and security frameworks/standards (OWASP, CVE, CVSS).
